answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 873 Country: India Title: Is it permissable for me to name my doughter Tooba Salma or Yusra Najeeba? Question: Is it permissable for me to name my doughter Tooba Salma or Yusra Najeeba? Answer ID: 873 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 444=432/N) You can keep any of the two names; both have good meaning. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
